title: Best 5 Tailors in Bangkok: A Detailed Comparison Guide
description: Selecting the perfect tailor in Bangkok can be as much about your travel schedule and budget as about styles and craftsmanship. Here's an in-depth look at five of the city’s top Tailors.

headings.text: 7 Things to Compare Before Choosing a Tailor in Bangkok
Which Bangkok Tailor Is Best for You?
Price Should Not Be the Only Deciding Factor

html:
Choosing the right tailor in Bangkok is not only about finding the lowest price or the fastest turnaround.

For many visitors, the decision also depends on how long they are staying in the city, how many fittings they can attend, what kind of fabric they want, and whether they prefer a fast traveler-focused service or a slower, more traditional bespoke process.

Bangkok has a large tailoring market, and the differences between shops can be significant. Some focus on speed and accessibility, while others place more emphasis on premium cloth, multiple fittings, or a boutique-style experience.

This guide compares five established Bangkok tailors across price, turnaround time, location, fitting process and overall strengths to help you decide which may suit your needs best.

1. Jesse & Son Custom Tailors

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 10, Asoke
Starting Price: From THB 11,500 for a suit
Typical Turnaround: Around 2–4 days, with express service possible in 48–72 hours when arranged in advance

Jesse & Son is a family-run Bangkok tailor located on Sukhumvit Soi 10, close to Asoke.

The business has more than 30 years of tailoring experience and operates its own workshop. The team includes around 25 full-time tailors, with garments going through fittings and quality control before delivery.

One of the main strengths is the balance between speed and a detailed fitting process. Express 48–72 hour tailoring can also be arranged for business travelers and wedding clients when the schedule is planned in advance.

Fabric choice is broad, covering entry-level wool blends and linen through to premium Italian and English mills. Half-canvas construction is standard on suits, with additional customization options available depending on fabric tier and package.

Why Choose Jesse & Son?

  • Strong option for international travelers with limited time
  • Entry-level suits currently start from THB 11,500
  • Express 48–72 hour tailoring available with advance planning
  • Own workshop and in-house tailoring team
  • Wide fabric selection from basic blends to premium Italian and English mills
  • Half-canvas construction as standard on suits

Ideal For: Travelers who want a personalized tailoring experience without needing to remain in Bangkok for a week or more.

2. Tailorworx

Location: Petchburi Soi 15, near Pratunam
Starting Price: THB 7,900 for a microfiber suit
Fittings: Minimum two fittings for suits

Tailorworx positions itself as a transparent, value-focused custom tailor with in-house production.

One of its clearest advantages is published pricing. Current suit prices range from entry-level microfiber through wool blends and pure wool to premium Italian fabrics.

Examples include:

  • Microfiber suits from THB 7,900
  • 50% wool-blend suits from THB 9,500
  • 80% wool-blend suits from THB 11,500
  • Pure Wool 120s from THB 15,000
  • Vitale Barberis Canonico from THB 19,000
  • Drago suits from THB 23,000

The shop also states that suits are produced in-house and that clients receive a minimum of two fittings.

Why Choose Tailorworx?

  • Clear published price list
  • Entry price currently starts at THB 7,900
  • In-house suit production
  • Minimum two suit fittings
  • Fabric options from microfiber to Italian wool
  • Easy to compare before visiting

Ideal For: Budget-conscious or first-time custom buyers who value transparent pricing and a straightforward process.

3. Universal Tailors

Location: Silom Road
Typical Turnaround: Around 3–5 days
Price: Varies according to fabric, construction and customization

Universal Tailors is one of the better-known tailoring names in the Silom area.

Most bespoke suits are completed in approximately 3–5 days and require multiple fittings, depending on the garment and fabric choice.

The business is associated with traditional suit construction and premium fabrics, including well-known Italian cloth options.

Universal also has a long track record with international clients, making it a practical choice for visitors who have several days available for fittings.

Why Choose Universal Tailors?

  • Established Silom location
  • Typical bespoke turnaround of 3–5 days
  • Multiple fittings
  • Traditional construction focus
  • Premium Italian fabric options
  • Better suited to clients who can allow more time for refinement

Ideal For: Business professionals and travelers who want a more traditional fitting process and are not working with the shortest possible itinerary.

4. Empire Tailors

Location: 124–126 Sukhumvit Main Road
Published Suit Price Estimate: Around USD $460–775
Published Turnaround: Around 3–4 days

Empire Tailors sits at a higher price point than many budget-focused Bangkok tailoring shops.

Published estimates place suit pricing at approximately USD $460–775, with the final cost depending on fabric and customization.

The shop is generally positioned around a more boutique-style experience with personalized service and multiple fittings.

Rather than competing primarily on low price, Empire is better suited to clients who are comfortable paying more for a premium fitting experience.

Why Choose Empire Tailors?

  • Boutique-style service
  • Published turnaround of around 3–4 days
  • Multiple fittings
  • Higher-end positioning
  • Convenient Sukhumvit location
  • Strong option for clients who prioritize service over bargain pricing

Ideal For: Clients who value premium fabrics, personalized service and a more refined fitting experience.

5. Louis Collections Bangkok

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 8, near BTS Nana
Starting Price: Around THB 18,000 for a bespoke suit
Typical Bespoke Timeline: Around 7–14 days depending on fabric, style and fittings

Louis Collections has been operating on Sukhumvit Road since 1985.

The business focuses on bespoke suits, wedding garments, business tailoring and formalwear, with tailoring completed in-house.

Current suit pricing starts from approximately THB 18,000 for premium wool, with higher pricing depending on fabric selection, canvas construction and additional garments.

Its longer bespoke timeline makes it better suited to clients who are staying in Bangkok for more than a few days and prefer additional time for fittings.

Why Choose Louis Collections?

  • Operating since 1985
  • Bespoke suits currently start around THB 18,000
  • In-house tailoring
  • Structured consultation and fitting process
  • Strong focus on business, wedding and formal tailoring
  • Suited to longer-stay clients

Ideal For: Clients staying in Bangkok longer who prefer a slower, more traditional bespoke process.

7 Things to Compare Before Choosing a Tailor in Bangkok

The best custom tailor Bangkok option for one person may not be the best for another.

Before making an appointment, compare these seven areas.

1. Your Available Time

This is particularly important for tourists.

A tailor may be able to finish a suit quickly, but you still need enough time for fittings and adjustments.

If you only have two or three days, tell the tailor your departure date before placing the order.

2. The Real Starting Price

A headline price does not always tell you what fabric or construction is included.

Ask what the entry price covers and whether upgrades such as better wool, full canvas, premium lining or hand finishing cost extra.

3. Fabric Choice

Look beyond the number of fabric books in the showroom.

Ask about fibre composition, weight, mill and suitability for your climate.

For a closer look at the materials available through our tailoring service, explore our suit and garment fabric collection.

4. Construction

Ask whether the jacket is fused, half-canvassed or fully canvassed.

Construction influences how the jacket feels and shapes over the body, and it can also explain why two apparently similar suits have very different prices.

Our guide to how we build a custom suit from scratch explains how fabric, measurements, construction, fittings and finishing come together through the tailoring process.

5. Number of Fittings

More fittings do not automatically guarantee a better garment, but fittings give the tailor opportunities to refine the result.

They are particularly important for first-time clients or anyone whose posture and proportions require adjustments beyond basic measurements.

If you are new to custom tailoring, our step-by-step guide to bespoke tailoring in Bangkok explains what happens from consultation through to final collection.

6. Where the Suit Is Made

Some Bangkok tailoring businesses have their own production teams, while others outsource some or all of the construction.

Neither model automatically determines quality, but it is reasonable to ask who will make the garment and where the work takes place.

You can read more about our workshop, history and tailoring approach on the About Jesse & Son page.

7. What Happens if Adjustments Are Needed?

Ask this before paying.

A good tailoring process should include a clear opportunity to correct fit issues before you leave Bangkok.

For international visitors, it is also worth asking whether the tailor keeps measurements or provides overseas shipping for future orders.

Which Bangkok Tailor Is Best for You?

The ranking matters less than finding the shop that matches your priorities.

Choose Jesse & Son if: you have a short Bangkok itinerary and want a combination of in-house tailoring, broad fabric choice and an express option.

Choose Tailorworx if: clearly published starting prices and lower entry costs are your main priorities.

Choose Universal Tailors if: you want a traditional Silom tailoring experience and have several days available for fittings.

Choose Empire Tailors if: you prefer a higher-end boutique environment and personalized service.

Choose Louis Collections if: you are staying longer and are comfortable with a more extended bespoke timeline.

This is why there is no single bespoke tailor Bangkok clients should automatically choose based only on a ranking. The best match depends on your time, budget, fabric expectations and preferred fitting experience.

Price Should Not Be the Only Deciding Factor

Bangkok's tailoring market covers everything from inexpensive tourist suits to premium bespoke garments using internationally recognized fabrics.

That means comparing shops based on price alone can be misleading.

A lower-priced and higher-priced suit may differ considerably in fabric, internal construction, fitting time, finishing and customization.

Before choosing, ask what you are actually receiving for the quoted price.

You can also review our tailoring pricing and fabric tiers to see how fabric choice and customization can affect the overall cost of a tailored garment.

The goal should not simply be to find the cheapest suit.

It should be to find the right balance between fit, fabric, construction, service, turnaround and budget.

Conclusion

At Jesse & Son, we believe choosing a tailor should be based on what matters most to you, whether that is turnaround time, fabric selection, construction, budget or the fitting experience itself. Bangkok offers a wide range of tailoring styles and price points, so taking time to compare what each shop actually provides can make the decision much easier. If you are looking for a tailor bangkok clients can work with for a personalized suit, multiple fabric options and a traveler-friendly fitting schedule, we would be happy to help you plan your commission.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a tailored suit cost in Bangkok?

Prices vary considerably. Entry-level tailoring can begin below THB 10,000 at some shops, while established bespoke and premium tailoring can cost significantly more depending on fabric and construction.

How long does a Bangkok tailor need to make a suit?

Some traveler-focused tailors can complete straightforward orders in 2–4 days, while other bespoke processes may take a week or longer. The number of fittings and complexity of the garment affect the timeline.

Can I get a bespoke suit made in Bangkok in three days?

Yes, some tailors offer three-day or 48–72 hour services. Arrange this in advance and allow time for fittings rather than visiting on your final day.

Is the cheapest Bangkok tailor always the best value?

No. Compare fabric, construction, number of fittings, finishing and alteration policy as well as price.

Should I book a tailor before arriving in Bangkok?

If your trip is short, booking ahead is a good idea. It gives the tailor advance notice of your schedule and lets you arrange the first appointment soon after arrival.

Which area of Bangkok has the most tailors?

Sukhumvit and Silom are two of the city's best-known tailoring areas, with many established shops located close to BTS and MRT stations.
